summary.en: Let your bots search and read your Notion pages
summary.zh: 讓 bot 搜尋、讀你的 Notion 頁面

label.en: What you allow on claude.ai (its page lists it when you connect)
label.zh: 你在 claude.ai 上允許的事（連結時頁面會列出來）

name.zh: 用 Claude 帳號的連接器

blurb.en: Connect once on claude.ai and every Claude tab on that account can use Notion. A browser is all you need: nothing to install. What it may do is set by the connector on claude.ai, not by ShellBot.
blurb.zh: 在 claude.ai 連結一次，這個帳號的 Claude 分頁都能用 Notion。只要瀏覽器，不用裝任何東西。它能做哪些事由 claude.ai 上的連接器決定，不是 ShellBot。

needs.en: Claude tabs signed in with a claude.ai account
needs.zh: Claude 分頁用 claude.ai 帳號登入

note.en: Claude tabs signed in with a claude.ai account see the connector.
note.zh: 用 claude.ai 帳號登入的 Claude 分頁拿得到這個連接器。

note.en: The claude.ai connector only reaches Claude tabs. Notion runs its own MCP server (mcp.notion.com) and its docs give the steps for this program; ShellBot does not set it up.
note.zh: claude.ai 的連接器只有 Claude 的分頁拿得到。Notion 有自己的 MCP 伺服器（mcp.notion.com），它的文件寫了這個程式怎麼加；ShellBot 不幫你設定。

note.en: The claude.ai connector only reaches Claude tabs. Notion runs its own MCP server (mcp.notion.com) and its docs give the steps for this program; ShellBot does not set it up.
note.zh: claude.ai 的連接器只有 Claude 的分頁拿得到。Notion 有自己的 MCP 伺服器（mcp.notion.com），它的文件寫了這個程式怎麼加；ShellBot 不幫你設定。

note.en: The claude.ai connector only reaches Claude tabs. Notion runs its own MCP server (mcp.notion.com); Notion's docs do not list this program, though its own docs say it takes remote MCP servers. ShellBot does not set it up.
note.zh: claude.ai 的連接器只有 Claude 的分頁拿得到。Notion 有自己的 MCP 伺服器（mcp.notion.com）；Notion 的文件沒列這個程式，但它自己的文件說可以加遠端 MCP 伺服器。ShellBot 不幫你設定。

note.en: The claude.ai connector only reaches Claude tabs. Notion runs its own MCP server (mcp.notion.com); Notion's docs do not list this program, though its own docs say it takes remote MCP servers. ShellBot does not set it up.
note.zh: claude.ai 的連接器只有 Claude 的分頁拿得到。Notion 有自己的 MCP 伺服器（mcp.notion.com）；Notion 的文件沒列這個程式，但它自己的文件說可以加遠端 MCP 伺服器。ShellBot 不幫你設定。

note.en: The claude.ai connector only reaches Claude tabs. Notion runs its own MCP server (mcp.notion.com) and its docs give the steps for this program; ShellBot does not set it up.
note.zh: claude.ai 的連接器只有 Claude 的分頁拿得到。Notion 有自己的 MCP 伺服器（mcp.notion.com），它的文件寫了這個程式怎麼加；ShellBot 不幫你設定。

note.en: The claude.ai connector only reaches Claude tabs. Pi has MCP built in since 0.99 and can add a remote server itself, such as Notion's own (mcp.notion.com); ShellBot does not set it up.
note.zh: claude.ai 的連接器只有 Claude 的分頁拿得到。Pi 從 0.99 版起內建 MCP，可以自己加遠端伺服器，例如 Notion 自己的（mcp.notion.com）；ShellBot 不幫你設定。

title.en: Is Claude signed in with a claude.ai account?
title.zh: Claude 是用 claude.ai 帳號登入的嗎？

how.en: ShellBot could not tell from what it keeps (it never opens a login file). With a Claude subscription it is: press Yes.
how.zh: ShellBot 從它記下的資料看不出來（它不會打開任何登入檔）。用的是 Claude 訂閱的話就是：按「是」。

how.en: Not sure? Type /status in a Claude tab and read the line that says how you are signed in.
how.zh: 不確定的話，在 Claude 分頁打 /status，看說明登入方式的那一行。

text.en: Signed in with a claude.ai account ({plan})
ShellBot cannot tell how Claude is signed in on this computer.
text.zh: ShellBot 看不出這台電腦的 Claude 是怎麼登入的。

hint.en: Type /status in a Claude tab and read the login line.
hint.zh: 在 Claude 分頁打 /status，看登入方式那一行。

q.en: Claude is signed in with an API key or a long-lived token
q.zh: Claude 是用 API key 或長效 token 登入的

a.en: Connectors only reach Claude tabs that are signed in with a claude.ai account. In a Claude tab type /login and pick the Claude account (subscription) option.
a.zh: 連接器只有用 claude.ai 帳號登入的 Claude 分頁才拿得到。在 Claude 分頁打 /login，選 Claude 帳號（訂閱）那一項。

q.en: I do not have a claude.ai account

a.en: The connector needs one. Sign up at claude.ai, then type /login in a Claude tab and pick the Claude account option.
a.zh: 連接器需要有 claude.ai 帳號。到 claude.ai 註冊後，在 Claude 分頁打 /login，選 Claude 帳號那一項。

how.en: Your browser opened Notion's page on claude.ai (sign in with the same claude.ai account if it asks). Press Connect there.
how.zh: 瀏覽器已打開 claude.ai 上 Notion 的頁面（它要你登入的話，用同一個 claude.ai 帳號）。在那裡按「連結」（Connect）。

how.en: In Notion's window pick the workspace Claude may reach, look at what it asks for, then allow it.
how.zh: Notion 的視窗：選你要讓 Claude 連結的工作空間，看完權限再允許。

how.en: Come back to ShellBot: it tests the connection by itself.
how.zh: 回到 ShellBot：它會自己測試通不通。

see.en: Back on claude.ai, Notion shows as connected.
see.zh: 回到 claude.ai，Notion 顯示已連結。

q.en: The page did not open, or it says the page is not there
q.zh: 頁面沒打開，或說找不到頁面

a.en: Open the connectors page instead and find Notion in the list.
a.zh: 改開連接器頁，在清單裡找 Notion。

q.en: There is no Connect button for Notion

a.en: On a company plan (Team or Enterprise) an owner has to turn the Notion connector on in the organization settings first; a member may see Request instead. Ask them, then come back to this step.
a.zh: 公司方案（Team、Enterprise）要先由管理員在組織設定裡開啟 Notion 連接器；成員看到的可能是「Request」。請管理員開好再回來。

q.en: claude.ai asks me to sign in and I do not know which account
q.zh: claude.ai 要我登入，不知道用哪個帳號

a.en: Use the account your Claude tabs are signed in with: connectors follow that account. Type /status in a Claude tab to see which one it is.
a.zh: 用你的 Claude 分頁登入的那個帳號：連接器是跟著這個帳號走的。在 Claude 分頁打 /status 就看得到是哪一個。

q.en: I pressed Connect and it failed, or it keeps spinning
q.zh: 按了連結之後失敗，或一直轉圈

a.en: Disconnect Notion on claude.ai, then connect it again.
a.zh: 在 claude.ai 先中斷 Notion，再連結一次。

q.en: I picked the wrong Notion workspace
q.zh: 選錯了 Notion 工作空間

a.en: Disconnect Notion on claude.ai, then connect again and pick the right workspace.
a.zh: 在 claude.ai 先中斷 Notion，再連結一次，這次選對工作空間。

intro.en: ShellBot opens a temporary Claude tab and asks it for one small lookup in Notion that only reads, reporting only how many items came back. Only that tab sees the result: ShellBot does not read, keep or log it.
intro.zh: ShellBot 會開一個臨時的 Claude 分頁，請它在 Notion 做一次唯讀的小查詢，只回報找到幾筆。結果只有那個分頁看得到：ShellBot 不讀、不存、不記錄。

text.zh: 正在開臨時的 Claude 分頁…

next.en: This usually takes about a minute. Only the test tab sees what comes back.
next.zh: 通常約一分鐘。結果只有測試分頁看得到。

text.en: Waiting for the tab to be ready…

next.en: This usually takes about a minute. Only the test tab sees what comes back.
next.zh: 通常約一分鐘。結果只有測試分頁看得到。

text.en: Asking it for one small lookup in Notion…
text.zh: 請它在 Notion 做一次小查詢…

next.en: This usually takes about a minute. Only the test tab sees what comes back.
next.zh: 通常約一分鐘。結果只有測試分頁看得到。

next.en: This usually takes about a minute. Only the test tab sees what comes back.
next.zh: 通常約一分鐘。結果只有測試分頁看得到。

text.en: The test tab is asking for your OK
text.zh: 測試分頁在等你按允許

next.en: It wants to use a Notion tool, and Claude asks before it does. Open the test conversation and choose Allow. The test goes on by itself afterwards.
next.zh: 它要用 Notion 的工具，Claude 會先問你。打開測試對話，選允許。之後測試會自己繼續。

next.en: The temporary test tab used the Notion connector. ShellBot does not read, keep or log what came back: it is only in the test tab's own conversation. A Claude tab that was already open before you connected Notion may need to be reopened before it sees it (not confirmed).
next.zh: 臨時的測試分頁用了 Notion 連接器。回來的內容 ShellBot 不讀、不存、不記錄：只在測試分頁自己的對話裡。連結之前就開著的 Claude 分頁，可能要重開才看得到 Notion（尚未證實）。

text.en: This one does not count. The test tab said it worked but never called a Notion tool.
text.zh: 這次不算：測試分頁說成功了，卻沒有叫過任何 Notion 工具。

next.en: Press "Test again". If it happens again, open the test conversation and see what the tab did.
next.zh: 按「重新測試」。再發生的話，打開測試對話看看分頁做了什麼。

text.en: It took too long. After 3 minutes the test tab had not finished.
text.zh: 等太久了：3 分鐘了，測試分頁還沒做完。

next.en: Most likely it is waiting for you. Open the test conversation: Claude may be asking you to allow a tool, or sitting on a sign-in screen.
next.zh: 最可能是在等你。打開測試對話看看：Claude 可能在問你要不要允許某個工具，或停在登入畫面。

text.en: No clear answer. The test tab used Notion, but it did not end with a clear result line.
text.zh: 沒有明確的結果：測試分頁用了 Notion，但最後沒有留下明確的結果那一行。

next.en: Open the test conversation to see how it ended, then press "Test again".
next.zh: 打開測試對話看它怎麼結束的，再按「重新測試」。

text.en: The test tab did not get ready. It never reached its prompt, so nothing was asked.
text.zh: 測試分頁沒有準備好：它一直沒有走到可以輸入的畫面，所以什麼都沒問。

next.en: Most likely Claude is not signed in. Open the test conversation: if it shows a sign-in screen, sign in there, then test again.
next.zh: 最可能是 Claude 還沒登入。打開測試對話：如果停在登入畫面，在那裡登入，再測一次。

text.en: The test tab was closed before it finished.
text.zh: 測試分頁沒做完就被關掉了。

text.en: Could not open the test tab.

next.en: Open a Claude tab yourself from the + button. If that works, press "Test again".
next.zh: 自己用 + 按鈕開一個 Claude 分頁。開得起來的話，再按「重新測試」。

text.en: Notion answered with an error. The test tab called Notion, but the answer ended in a failure.
text.zh: Notion 回了錯誤：測試分頁叫了 Notion，但結果是失敗。

next.en: Most likely a short-lived limit or a timeout: wait a few minutes and test again. If it keeps failing, go back to step 2 and connect it again.
next.zh: 最可能是暫時的額度或逾時：等幾分鐘再測一次。一直失敗的話，回到第 2 步重新連結一次。

text.en: The connector is not authorized yet. The test tab found the Notion connector, but it asked to be authorized first.
text.zh: 連接器還沒授權好：測試分頁找得到 Notion 連接器，但它說要先授權。

next.en: Go back to step 2: on claude.ai disconnect Notion, then connect it again and allow it.
next.zh: 回到第 2 步：在 claude.ai 先中斷 Notion，再連結一次並允許。

text.en: Not yet. The test tab did not find any Notion tool.
text.zh: 還沒通：測試分頁沒有找到任何 Notion 工具。

next.en: Most likely Notion is not connected on claude.ai yet: go back to step 2. Next: Claude is not signed in with a claude.ai account (an API key cannot see connectors); type /status in a Claude tab. Also: in the test tab type /mcp and see whether the claude.ai Notion connector is turned off.
next.zh: 最可能：Notion 在 claude.ai 上還沒連結，回到第 2 步。其次：這台的 Claude 不是用 claude.ai 帳號登入（API key 看不到連接器），在 Claude 分頁打 /status 確認。另外：在測試分頁打 /mcp，看 claude.ai 的 Notion 連接器是不是被關掉了。

q.en: What does the connection test look at?

a.en: The names of the tools the test tab called, and its last line. ShellBot does not read what the tools returned; the test tab is not a bot, so closing it leaves nothing in any bot's memory.
a.zh: 測試分頁叫過哪些工具（只看名稱），和它最後一行。ShellBot 不讀工具傳回的內容；測試分頁不是 bot，關掉它不會留在任何 bot 的記憶裡。

q.en: How do I take Notion back?

a.en: Disconnect in ShellBot only forgets its progress: it added nothing to the AIs' settings for this way. The connector itself is on claude.ai: disconnect Notion there.
a.zh: 在 ShellBot 按中斷，只會忘掉它記下的進度：這種連結方式 ShellBot 沒有改任何 AI 的設定。連接器本身在 claude.ai：到那裡中斷 Notion。

q.en: Can other AI tabs use Notion?
q.zh: 其他 AI 分頁能用 Notion 嗎？

a.en: Not through this connector: it only reaches Claude tabs. What each other program offers on its own is noted per program; ShellBot does not set those up.
a.zh: 不能透過這個連接器：它只有 Claude 的分頁拿得到。其他程式自己有沒有連結方式，各自記在那個程式底下；ShellBot 不幫你設定那些。
